title: Kuwait-flagged tanker hit by projectile in Strait of Hormuz
excerpt: A Kuwait-flagged tanker was struck by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz, causing a fire, with reports of multiple tankers hit over 1-2 October.
x_post: A Kuwait-flagged tanker was hit by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz, causing a fire. Russia claimed drone strikes on a cargo vessel in the Black Sea. #MaritimeSecurity #StraitOfHormuz #BlackSea #Seafarers
